description:
Get the Lookalike Watch subscription, in the shape subscribe_lookalike_watch returned it. 404 when the account never subscribed.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_lookalike_watch

outputSchema.description: The account's Lookalike Watch subscription. Subscribe, read and cancel all answer it; only the cancel answer reads `canceled`, since a read after cancelling answers 404.

activated_at.description: When the watch was last turned on (stamped again on reactivation)

last_report_period.description: The last month reported, `YYYY-MM`; null before the first report
